recognize_zh: 中倍下單調、中等大小的腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫片狀，在粉紅色纖維／肌肉束之間浸潤生長，其間散布許多含吞噬碎屑的巨噬細胞形成星空樣（starry sky）；需以 FISH 確認 MYC 與 BCL2 重排。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio
Scattered tingible-body macrophages producing a starry-sky pattern
Infiltration between and dissecting dense eosinophilic fibromuscular bundles
Numerous apoptotic bodies; no residual nodal or follicular architecture in the field
describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, highly cellular infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells that dissects between thick eosinophilic fibromuscular bundles. The tumor cells have scant cytoplasm and a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, and numerous scattered tingible-body macrophages impart a starry-sky appearance. No residual normal architecture is identified in this field. The findings indicate an aggressive B-cell lymphoma with high proliferative activity; the differential includes Burkitt lymphoma and high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, and FISH is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Burkitt also shows a starry sky but is BCL2-negative with MYC rearrangement alone, whereas double-hit lymphoma is typically BCL2-positive with both MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.
DLBCL usually has larger, more pleomorphic cells and lacks concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements on FISH.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finely dispersed blastic chromatin and is TdT-positive.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1- and SOX11-positive.
